messages:
Leah (AE): Heads-up — FreightPilot wants a 2-week trial starting Tue. They need streaming SDK + function-calls producing structured JSON output, and a short presales runbook. Can someone confirm the handshake steps, quick security asks, and a rough hosted vs dedicated cost ballpark for ~50 qps peak?

Omar (SE): I can own the runbook. High level checklist:
1) SDK init (API key / ephemeral creds)
2) Handshake (websocket/sse) + short-lived token exchange
3) Enable function/tool calling with schema mapping
4) Structured output schema + validation tests
5) Telemetry + backpressure (client side)

Omar (SE): Sample init (node):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'openlite-1-7b', mode: 'sse' });
stream.on('data', (msg) => parseStructured(msg));
```

Omar (SE): For function/tool-calls we recommend sending a compact JSON schema and pre-registering allowed tool endpoints (no open egress). We'll include a test harness that asserts type/keys.

Priya (Platform Eng): Security notes from their questionnaire: they want KMS-managed keys for at-rest creds, IP allowlist, and evidence of data residency for EU. Also asking whether we can provide SSO + delegated roles for the SDK. If they move to Private/Dedicated they'll expect a run-of-the-mill SOC2 snippet and an audit log export.

Leah (AE): Good — can you confirm whether hosted can meet 50 qps without dedicated commit? They prefer not to sign reserved capacity until the pilot proves value. Also they asked about estimated token volume — they gave avg 600 tokens per request and 50 qps peak for 2 hours/day, and 10 qps baseline rest.

Omar (SE): Quick back-of-envelope: peak burst window 2 hours/day at 50 qps -> 50 * 3600 * 2 = 360k requests during burst. Avg tokens/request 600 -> 216M tokens for burst window per day. Baseline 10 qps rest of day -> 10*3600*22=792k requests -> ~475M tokens. That's large; double-check their numbers. If those token counts are accurate, hosted per-token costs will be non-trivial — dedicated reserved GPU for optimized quantized model likely cheaper.

Priya (Platform Eng): Also note streaming reduces overhead if you can stream partial tokens, but structured outputs often require full completion for schema validation. Recommend trying a smaller prompt/template and enabling prefix caching on our side.

Leah (AE): Pricing ask — can you give a 2-week quote: hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs minimal Dedicated (monthly pro-rata) with a buffer for bursts? I need something to share with procurement today.

Omar (SE): I'll draft two numbers: hosted estimate (token * hostedRate + request overhead) and Dedicated pro-rata (one ND-type pool for 2 weeks at 40% utilization). Will attach assumptions.

infra-bot: Reminder: submit presales infra request at least 48h before trial start for ephemeral creds & IP allowlist provisioning.

Priya (Platform Eng): For the security questionnaire items I can pre-fill standard answers and flag any 'no' items. Also suggest we offer a short SOC2 excerpt and an architecture diagram (VPC + KMS flow).

Leah (AE): Perfect. Omar — runbook draft and cost estimate by EOD? Priya — security draft by EOD as well? I'll sync with FreightPilot and confirm Tuesday 10:00am PST kickoff. :thumbsup:

Omar (SE): Yup — will post runbook link here when done.

Priya (Platform Eng): I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt and a checklist for on-prem vs hosted items.

Leah (AE): Thanks team — main blockers likely pricing delta and IP/KMS requirements. We'll surface those early in kickoff.

(threads typically short — will follow up with links and attach files)
